title: TENSAR PARA HACER ESPACIO
concept: A rectangular frame supporting a saddle shaped tensioned membrane with alternating high and low corners, from the user's page 3. Main large exploded axon: rigid perimeter frame, cable edges, replaceable fabric strips, four adjustable tie points, ground anchors outside the walking zone. Beside it 3 small same-view states as one corner rises, plus a large section with people showing low threshold and tall central gathering space. Bottom 3 applications: bench canopy, covered linear passage, four-corner pavilion. Tension arrows follow edge cables; do not draw fabric carrying compression. Small zoomed clevis and turnbuckle node. Exact title '01 / TENSAR PARA HACER ESPACIO'. Labels 'anclar', 'elevar', 'tensar', 'umbral bajo', 'centro libre', 'borde activo', 'banco', 'pasaje', 'pabellón'. Footer 'Exploración conceptual · geometría por ensayar'.

title: PLEGAR Y DESPLEGAR
concept: Use user's page 5 repeated hourglass profiles and accordion membranes as origin. Main drawing a beautiful folding pavilion made of six pin-jointed portal ribs connected by pleated translucent fabric, deployed along rails recessed at outer edge. Show packed / half-open / fully-open sequence in consistent axon. Include clear scissor linkage exploded pivot and separate bracing locking pin so the structure is stable only in locked configuration. Three formal branches: straight accordion gallery, fan canopy, bent zigzag room (independent hinge modules). Human figures beneath deployed canopy; no person within movement sweep. Title '02 / PLEGAR Y DESPLEGAR'. Labels 'recogido', 'intermedio', 'abierto', 'bisagra', 'bloqueo', 'guía', 'galería', 'abanico', 'zigzag'. Footer 'Mover transforma el uso; bloquear estabiliza'.

title: GIRAR PARA ABRIR
concept: Develop the user's page 4 overlapping circular rooms and radial diagrams as mechanically honest rotating screens in a fixed frame. Main axon a low circular pavilion with fixed slender columns and radial roof, and independently pivoting lightweight translucent curved screen segments on protected hinges. Show 3 equal-scale plans: inward intimate circle, open social arcs, porous perimeter. Draw curved arrows on individual screen pivots, dashed motion sweeps never colliding with people, no entire building revolving. Detail exploded hinge with stop and lock. Three derivatives: rotating wall, opening flower canopy with hub, cluster of separated ring rooms. Title '03 / GIRAR PARA ABRIR'. Labels 'eje fijo', 'hoja móvil', 'tope', 'cerrar', 'filtrar', 'abrir', 'círculo', 'pétalos', 'constelación'. Footer 'Cada giro modifica un umbral'.

title: CRECER POR PIEZAS
concept: From user's page 5 chain of hexagonal cells and square grid, plus modular architecture references, draw main exploded axon of 7 rectangular cuboid pavilion frames stepped in PLAN around a generous common courtyard, some solid infill boxes some translucent skins. Ground-level accessible circulation, optional single raised viewing room with visible stair but main program ground level. Show connection detail bolted reversible plate, structural frame vs independent removable infill. 4 plan grammar diagrams: line, branching, courtyard, dispersed field. Bottom evolution 1 module -> 3 -> 7, leave voids intentional. Title '04 / CRECER POR PIEZAS'. Labels 'pieza', 'unión seca', 'vacío común', 'añadir', 'retirar', 'línea', 'racimo', 'patio', 'campo'. Footer 'El vacío también es una pieza'.

title: HABITAR ENTRE CAPAS
concept: Translate the user's page 2 large central room with peripheral chambers and wavy boundaries into transparent box-in-box pavilion. Main deeply detailed exploded axon: rigid outer rectilinear frame and translucent weather veil, independent smaller warm yellow/coral enclosed acoustic chamber, service strip, clear inhabitable interval between inner and outer skins. Reveal thresholds, seat thickness, light-filter panels and permeable soffit. Include section showing airflow paths without quantified performance; 3 alternate spatial forms: offset inner cube, suspended visual-only lightweight lantern above clear floor supported from frame, nested curved room inside box. Small transparency gradient swatches and illustrated human use. Title '05 / HABITAR ENTRE CAPAS'. Labels 'piel exterior', 'cámara interior', 'espesor habitable', 'filtro', 'pausa', 'luz', 'descentrar', 'suspender', 'envolver'. Footer 'Dos límites producen un tercer espacio'.

title: EL SUELO CONSTRUYE LA FORMA
concept: From user's page 1 ramp, stage, audience tiers and wavy roof, create expressive long sectional perspective of pavilion where a warm yellow continuous ground ribbon becomes seating, stage edge and promenade beneath a separate light cyan curved canopy. Show physically connected broad gentle alternative route bypassing seating steps. Ground surface changes level; roof supported on slender perimeter frames, no unsupported slab. Small serial sections: flat gathering, folded seating, bowl gathering. Main figure procession walking, sitting, performing. Include drainage edge schematic, small exploded dry floor cassette and support legs. Title '06 / EL SUELO CONSTRUYE LA FORMA'. Labels 'recorrer', 'sentarse', 'reunirse', 'actuar', 'ruta continua', 'borde', 'plano', 'pliegue', 'cuenco'. Footer 'La sección organiza los cuerpos'.

title: UNA PIEL QUE REGULA
concept: Environmental mechanism concept panel of one rectilinear small pavilion with sloped pleated translucent roof derived from page 3 and 5, externally shading fins, low screened openings and adjustable high vent, rain draining to outer gutter and visible detachable downpipe into sealed tank. Main beautiful cutaway axon inhabited by seated people. Distinct small sections labelled sun, breeze, rain, night; arrows logically show solar shade, conditional cross-ventilation, drainage, diffused internal light. No temperature claims, no mist or HVAC magic. Exploded corner detail combines independent shade layer, rain layer, ventilated gap. Title '07 / UNA PIEL QUE REGULA'. Labels 'sombra', 'aire', 'lluvia', 'noche', 'capa de sombra', 'cámara', 'canalón', 'depósito'. Footer 'Hipótesis climáticas pendientes de ensayo'.

title: UN PABELLÓN COMO INSTRUMENTO
concept: Create experimental sensory pavilion where tensioned membranes and tuned hanging strips from user's tent sketches become an instrument, within fixed light rectangular support frame. Main large cutaway detailed section-perspective: ground vibration sensor shown beneath a removable floor inspection hatch, wired to visible controller and powered amplifier in accessible service box, cable to small tactile transducer on isolated seated bench; adjacent fabric sail responds passively to airflow, clearly separate causal path. Human touches bench; no claim passive sensor creates power. Small causal diagram 'suelo' -> 'sensor' -> 'control' -> 'actuador' -> 'cuerpo', external power branch 'energía'. Three spatial applications: tactile bench, suspended light strips, quiet listening chamber. Show no exaggerated hazard vibration. Title '08 / UN PABELLÓN COMO INSTRUMENTO'. Other labels 'membrana', 'banco táctil', 'aire', 'escucha'. Footer 'Respuesta sensorial propuesta; requiere prototipo'.

title: MONTAR, REPARAR, VOLVER A USAR
concept: A wonderfully detailed architect's assembly panel. Main exploded axon of one small 4-post pavilion with fixed braced tubular frame, modular deck, triangulated roof subframe, tensioned replaceable membrane panels and clip-on movable screens. Every element has a physical location, ground anchors at feet outside accessible floor. Lower sequential vignettes assembly: prepare base, bolt frame with temporary braces, add roof and permanent braces, tension fabric, occupy only after locking. Larger details bolted foot with conceptual foundation block marked 'base por calcular', removable fabric edge track, accessible joint. A material family strip visually compare textile / translucent sheet / mesh / solid board as alternatives not all simultaneous. Title '09 / MONTAR, REPARAR, VOLVER A USAR'. Labels 'base', 'marco', 'arriostrar', 'tensar', 'habitar', 'atornillar', 'sustituir', 'recuperar'. Footer 'Despiece conceptual; secciones y anclajes por calcular'.

title: TRES FORMAS DESDE LA TENSIÓN
concept: Three genuinely different pavilion proposals across a landscape architectural board, each same visual emphasis and comparable human scale, each accompanied by precise small plan, section, and generative 3-step diagram. Left 'EL VALLE': rectangular exterior frame with inward dipped translucent tensile saddle roof, clear ground and raised perimeter, low edge threshold and high path, stable corner anchors. Center 'EL BOSQUE': six separate conical textile umbrellas on slender poles over free curving ground route; circular tensile rings or guy cables appropriately anchored, people below. Right 'LA OLA': sequential tall curved portal ribs supporting translucent pleated double-curved roof over linear stepped seating plus clear parallel path. Sophisticated fine black line axons, cyan skins, magenta tendons and ochre people. Title '10 / TRES FORMAS DESDE LA TENSIÓN'. Labels below each 'anclar → variar alturas → tensar', 'repetir → separar → conectar', 'repetir → desplazar → cubrir'. Footer 'Tres hipótesis formales abiertas'.

title: TRES FORMAS DESDE EL MÓDULO
concept: Landscape board with three distinctive ground-level pavilion proposals of equal weight in rich detailed axon, each small coherent plan and section below, consistent human scale. Left 'EL ARCHIPIÉLAGO': seven small rectangular frames, mix translucent boxes and empty pergolas, dispersed around central ground-level common court, path linking them. Center 'LA CAJA POROSA': a single transparent cuboid frame holding offset smaller solid colored rooms within it, inhabitable interstitial space, void through center, no huge urban tower. Right 'EL CLAUSTRO ABIERTO': C-shaped sequence of rectangular modules enclosing one planted open court and wide open entry, translucent pleated roof on outer ring. Show generating operations in small clear diagrams. Title '11 / TRES FORMAS DESDE EL MÓDULO'. Labels 'separar → vincular', 'envolver → descentrar', 'agrupar → vaciar'. Footer 'Misma familia de piezas; tres formas de reunir'.

title: CRUZAR MECANISMOS, ABRIR IDEAS
concept: Final landscape research board with three compelling architecturally distinct hybrid pavilion proposals, connected by a clear small operation map, no dense text. Left 'PLAZA DESPLEGABLE': accordion linked portal frames unfold along two parallel sides of an open social space, textile roof and folded seat floor, arrows show deploy then lock. Center 'JARDÍN DE UMBRALES': nested circular translucent screen clusters and fixed conical canopies in a low garden, individual screens pivot to connect or isolate rooms, broad walking route. Right 'LINTERNA HABITABLE': cuboid outer translucent skin, independent central listening room and tactile bench, a low continuous ramp around it and hanging fabric within, a luminous night interior inset. Each has small plan with people and schematic system exploded into three layers. Title '12 / CRUZAR MECANISMOS, ABRIR IDEAS'. Labels 'plegar + recorrer', 'girar + agregar', 'envolver + resonar'. Footer 'Elegir una operación, una experiencia y una forma'.
